intro: Georgia has about 3.7 million people, most of them Georgian Orthodox Christians.

chapters.title: People and language
text: Georgian has its own alphabet of 33 curly letters and is unrelated to its neighbours' languages. There are Azerbaijani and Armenian minorities.
Family, church and the supra feast, led by a toastmaster called the tamada, are central to life.

chapters.title: Cities
text: About a third of people live in Tbilisi, the capital. Many Georgians work abroad.
